title: 3658. GCD of Odd and Even Sums

examples.explanation: Sum of the first 4 odd numbers sumOdd = 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16 Sum of the first 4 even numbers sumEven = 2 + 4 + 6 + 8 = 20 Hence, GCD(sumOdd, sumEven) = GCD(16, 20) = 4.
Sum of the first 5 odd numbers sumOdd = 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25 Sum of the first 5 even numbers sumEven = 2 + 4 + 6 + 8 + 10 = 30 Hence, GCD(sumOdd, sumEven) = GCD(25, 30) = 5.
